status: Original source-data interchange; not a runtime asset approval or renderer contract.

identity.archive: JS5 index number, e.g. 7 models, 5 maps, 8 sprites, 13 font metrics
identity.file: Inner file ID, not assumed identical to the group ID
identity.integrity: Whole ZIP SHA-256; every original disk-file SHA-256; selected compressed group CRC/full revision/version trailer and SHA-256; original decompressed payload SHA-256; output and uncompressed JSON hashes.
identity.definition_files: Config index 2: underlays group1, overlays4, objects6, NPCs9, items10, sequences12.
identity.source_empty_meshes: Explicitly retained and marked; never counted as representative renderable geometry.

world.source_group: index5/group=region_id, inner file0 terrain and file1 locations
world.world_coordinates: world_x=region_x*64+local_x, world_y=region_y*64+local_y; x increases east, y north; plane is separate.
world.heights: Original client height units; negative is up. One tile is 128 model/local units. Explicit height bytes or RuneLite's pinned source noise/upper-plane derivation produce the heights; encoded_heights also preserve source bytes (-1 denotes implicit height).
world.floor_definition_lookup: Tile underlay/overlay 0 means absent; positive tile ID references definition ID minus1. Preserve source shape, rotation, settings/bridge/roof information.
world.placements: All source placements, including scenery and upper floors. No coordinate recentering, relocation or density sampling.
world.object_closure: Every placed object definition, all source morph destinations, their model IDs, animation IDs and ambient sounds. Morph/varbit state is not guessed.
world.instances: Source map squares are not live instance chunk-copy maps. Death's Office source square12633 is identified by coffer39550 at3179,5729; live entry/instance state remains unverified.
world.boundary: Conservative extraction rectangles are not approved game boundaries or camera/draw-distance settings; absent source-index squares are listed, not synthesized.

models.coordinates: Native signed integer model X,Y,Z. X and Z are horizontal local axes, Y is vertical with negative up. No axis/handedness conversion, resizing, centering, rotation, smoothing, welding or decimation was applied.
models.topology: vertexX/Y/Z and faceIndices1/2/3 preserve source vertex/triangle order and winding. Signed short/byte storage is retained in source fields; apply unsigned masks where the original client does.
models.materials: faceColors are packed unsigned16 OSRS HSL, not RGB/PBR base colors; faceTextures use -1 for none. Keep render types, priorities, transparency, depth offsets and texture coordinate/triangle metadata.
models.hsl_layout: Hue=(value>>10)&63, saturation=(value>>7)&7, lightness=value&127. Original lighting/brightness/palette behavior must be reproduced, not replaced by a generic PBR shader.
models.transparency: Interpret source byte modulo256: source0 is opaque, source255 transparent. Preserve native compositing and face priority behavior.
models.derived_data: Pinned RuneLite computeNormals/computeTextureUVCoordinates outputs are provided separately as vertex_normals, face_normals, face_texture_u/v. They are not reference rendering proof.
models.assembly: Object definitions retain type-specific model selection, rotations, sizes, offsets, contouring, recolors and retextures. NPC definitions retain ordered parts, scales, recolors/retextures and animations. Item definitions retain model/icon rotations/zoom/offsets/equipment/note/stack links.
models.representative_tree: Object1277 -> model1570 (90 vertices,110 faces); recolor3470->5029 must be applied.
models.representative_goblin: NPC3028 -> models24458,24482,24431,24472,24441,24448. Preserve part assembly and source animation groups.
models.penguin_candidate: NPC2063 -> model21547 (200 vertices,396 faces), widthScale=heightScale=75 relative to128. No player adaptation, recoloring or equipment fitting approved.
models.geometry_limits: Per-model vertex/face counts and native bounds are in the canonical full-bundle records.
models.pivot: Original model origin retained; definition offsets/contouring not baked.
models.attachments: Original transform/skin groups retained. No invented penguin attachment points or completed modular equipment contract.
models.lod_and_optimization: No LOD generation or optimization; original source inputs only.

textures.source: index9/group0/file=texture_id plus referenced index8 sprite groups
textures.payload: Original texture definition layer IDs, color/tint fields and animation fields; referenced RGBA sprites, palettes and pixel indices.
textures.sampling_and_shading: No filtering, gamma, brightness or animation speed baked. Source renderer calibration remains an approval prerequisite.

sprites_fonts_interfaces.sprite_files: sprites/{group}.png and sprites/{group}.json.gz; at most16 atlas columns, cell size equals max source canvas dimensions.
sprites_fonts_interfaces.pixels: RGBA8 PNG with straight alpha. Native palettes and unsigned palette indices are also retained. No replacement artwork or smoothing.
sprites_fonts_interfaces.font_files: fonts/{group}.json references the same numbered glyph sprite group; 256 CP1252-indexed glyphs, exact advances and ascent.
sprites_fonts_interfaces.kerning: All selected metrics use original257-byte format, which contains no kerning table. Extended unsupported metrics fail rather than dropping data.
sprites_fonts_interfaces.interfaces: Source widget IDs are (group<<16)|file. All original coordinates/layout flags/text/colors/visibility/listeners and direct sprite/font references are retained.
sprites_fonts_interfaces.limitations: Decoded widgets do not establish dynamic script effects, stock Resizable-Classic behavior or generated item icons. The383x503 title.jpg is a source component, not a calibrated screen capture.

animations.legacy: Sequences retain native frame IDs/lengths, looping/interleave/priority and source sound-event data. packed_frame=(index0_group<<16)|file. FrameDefinition stores translator arrays/count, indexFrameIds and framemap.
animations.skeletons: Index1/group=skeleton_id/file0. Legacy types/frameMaps/length are decoded; original bytes also remain in full output. Model packed vertex/transparency groups and animaya group/scale arrays are retained.
animations.timing: Frame lengths remain native client-cycle quantities; they are not converted to server ticks or asserted to match captured wall-clock playback.
animations.cached_curves: Sequence animMayaID is packed (index22_group<<16)|file. The original versioned curve bytes and referenced skeleton are preserved; curve decoder/playback and extended bind-pose semantics are not claimed complete.
animations.rendering: No retargeting, interpolation rewrite, animation playback acceptance or equipment-fit validation.

audio.music: Index6 named groups decoded from Jagex track encoding to Standard MIDI, retaining original source bytes. Name/hash assertions select Scape Main0, Newbie Melody62, Scape Cave144, Harmony76, Autumn Voyage2.
audio.sfx: Index4 source sound bytes plus decoded envelope/oscillator/filter definitions for requested and scene/sequence referenced sounds.
audio.synthesis_inputs: Every original index14 compressed sample and Vorbis setup group0, and all index15 instrument patches, are preserved in full extraction.
audio.limitations: No generic soundfont, synthesized replacement, source recording or actual playback claim. Original synthesis, triggers, volumes, transitions and loop timing remain to be validated.

publication.full_bundle: assets/manifests/osrs/cache2695-full-bundle.json.gz lists all actual output files, including ignored full model and audio inputs.
publication.collections: collections/{kind}.json.gz is an asset-ID-keyed map aggregating original decoded JSON values without semantic modification.
publication.reproduction: python3 tools/cache-import/import_cache.py fetch && python3 tools/cache-import/import_cache.py extract && python3 tools/cache-import/import_cache.py publish
publication.approval: Owner reference-pack approval and final presentation/gameplay acceptance remain separate and false.
